Rumors point to Apple’s new N1 wireless chip with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread support, along with a major performance jump from the A15 Bionic to a potential A17 Pro chip.
If that happens, the next Apple TV could support faster streaming, lower latency gaming, and possibly even Apple Intelligence features tied to the next generation of Siri on tvOS.
